scope: New EURUSD-only input adapter and new fixture tests. All preexisting registered sources, runtime data, configuration, workers and account/order surfaces untouched by this subtask.

capture_contract.maturity_semantics: UTC M1 START plus60seconds; actual observation follows stable byte read
capture_contract.learning_availability: retained older labels become usable only at actual current source observation; later computation completion required

validated_behavior: Missing or malformed peer archives have no effect and are never read.
512 retained old plus61 current EURUSD closes produce exactly the two requested local families; supervised labels mature before reopening in that fixture.
Old EURUSD holes remain absent and allow unaffected historical segments; a recent own-pair hole still causes explicit warmup abstention.
Capture digest, retained source hashes, exact byte geometry, schema/inert identities, all derived fields, maturity/freshness boundaries and actual observation clocks are revalidated.
Nonzero sub-microsecond timestamps cannot truncate into an exact minute; zero nanoseconds and equivalent nonzero timezone offsets are supported.
Hash-verified model bytes execute fresh rather than trusting cached modules or pyc; unavailable family or backwards completion clock abstains the entire batch.
limitations: This new companion requires separate registration and activation by the parent; this subtask did not start it.
Readiness is not improved prediction accuracy or trading approval.
